title: Anyone visit the "Island?"
content: I keep visiting an island. Ill leave or arrive from "mallworld" type airport. I always stay at a specific resort. Just now was dreaming of some of type event at a huge bar with a ceiling thats 4 stories high. The Bar is in the middle of the room. Got really drunk and invited people back to my suite which was basically it's own mini mansion with all types of pools. The staff is friendly but rarely seen. Sometimes the room will be simple with sliding glass doors facing the ocean and opening up on to a deck with two chairs, a table and umbrella. It has stairs that go down to a boardwalk path through grassy dunes. Theres a lagoon type boardwalk town with restaurants. Ive been to a few resorts there but usually end up at the same one. Been to another one that resembles the Atlantis hotel kind of. Reception there is a huge royal red and gold theme with 3 elevators, giant pillars, and the front wall of the reception room is glass. The carpet is really thick velvet with Persian rug walkways. The gold trim is aet deco-ish. I can go on and on. Anyone else visit here? I can't AI with this one, I need to start painting these or 3d model them.
